visual.general_description: Grayscale radiograph of a knee in frontal projection showing bright joint-replacement components, a small bright screw in the proximal lower leg and a letter R marker.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale radiograph, portrait orientation, of a knee and the adjacent distal thigh and proximal lower leg in frontal projection. A large uniformly bright component with a rounded outline caps the lower end of the thigh bone, and a flat bright plate with a downward-pointing stem sits at the upper end of the lower leg bones; a dark gap separates the two components. A black plus-shaped marker lies over the upper part of the thigh-side component. A thin elongated bright screw-like object lies obliquely in the upper lower-leg bone, and small bright dash-like markers run in a vertical row along the lower leg and in a short row above the thigh-side component. A small letter R appears at the right margin. No panel letters, arrows, scale bar, measurement values, dates or name text are visible.
